plan.notes: Transcribed verbatim from the official ASU-Newport AY2026-2027 'Associate of Arts Degree — General Education' degree plan (CIP 24.0101, Degree Code 0110; revision date 01/28/2026). Four-semester plan: 13 + 16 + 16 + 15 = 60 total hours, matching the printed 'Total Required Credit Hours (60)'. Institutional Requirement (10 cr): SPCH 10003 + UNIV 10001 + 6 cr elective from any discipline. General Education Elective (6 cr) from the catalog's 22-course list; Directed Electives (15 cr) from any course 1000-level or above with prefixes ARHS, BIOL, CHEM, ECON, ENGL, GEOG, GEOL, HIST, MATH, MUSC, PHIL, PHSC, PHYS, PLSC, PSSC, PSYC, SPCH, SOCI, SPAN, THTR. BIOL **** slots are choice slots using the catalog's placeholder; PHYSICAL SCIENCE **** slots likewise. The Year 2-Semester 2 slot printed as 'HIST 11013' with ACTS HIST1113 is transcribed verbatim (the elective list elsewhere prints HIST 11103 for World Civilization to 1660). NC 'Possible Prerequisites' are placement/developmental courses valid as prereqs but not part of the plan, recorded in external_prereqs. transfer_confidence is 'core_only' (standard AA transfer; ACTS equivalencies shown where the source prints them).
